question_en:
Collection digitization staff need to screen mineral photos for the "Purple Crystal Clusters" special topic. The complete scope includes all files in the Wikimedia Commons category "Minerals in Naturalis Leiden" with filenames starting with "WLANL -". Please answer:

After examining the main image of each file one by one, which main specimens have clear, continuous purple areas where dense, repeating crystal face textures are visible? Provide a complete itemized table containing "Filename, Number of Main Specimens, Visibility Status of Purple Crystal Clusters". Which files belong to the two groups "Purple Crystal Clusters Clearly Visible" and "No Purple Crystal Clusters Observed", and what is the count for each group?

Observe only the main specimen itself; do not count purple areas on background screens, display case reflections, or other non-specimen regions. Each member of the full set must appear only once, and the sum of the counts of the two groups must equal the total number of the full set.

The answer must include a complete itemized table of "Filename—Number of Main Specimens—Visibility Status of Purple Crystal Clusters", followed by a Q&A section listing the files and counts for each of the two groups separately.

# Detailed Simulated Retrieval Trajectory · 1-2-E01

## Step 01 · parse_task / Clarify set, image unit, and delivery fields

Action: Read the prompt, separate "complete scope," "visual conditions," "itemized table," and "summary"; first establish the full member list, then perform filtering.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): All files in the Commons category Minerals in Naturalis Leiden with filenames starting with "WLANL -" are judged one by one by file identity.

Unified judgment rule: Observe only the main specimen itself: clear, continuous purple areas and dense, repeating crystal face textures within those areas must both be present. Purple areas on background screens, display case reflections, or other non-specimen regions are not counted. Each image must also record the number of main specimens.

Result of this step: Determine the current predicate; each formal member retains only one row; do not retrieve or report only positive examples.

## Step 02 · search / Locate the collection entry for the specified institution

Action: Example query: "Wikimedia Commons Minerals in Naturalis Leiden WLANL". From the search candidates, verify the publishing institution, title, and version, then open the specified collection or publication entry.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): Traceable sources include frozen Commons API query.pages, descriptionurl and imageinfo main image addresses for each file, and a count of 15 main specimens. The entry provides all candidates and their image associations, not a partial sample constructed from the final hit list.

Evidence links:
- Collection/version entry: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Minerals_in_Naturalis_Leiden

Result of this step: Lock the following real source URLs, then expand members within them.

## Step 03 · enumerate / Recover the full set and stable identity keys

Action: First read all members of the category and handle possible continuation pages, then filter by the exact "WLANL -" filename prefix. A category review on October 8 found 18 items in total, of which 15 matched the prefix, consistent with the frozen API member set; photos with the same name plus (1)/(2) are still different files and are not merged by mineral type.

## Step 04 · bind_image / Bind each member to the specified image

Action: Item-by-item verification of name/number, page number or position, and official main image, attachment, or plate address; prepare mapping for sequential image opening in the next round.

Evidence observation (archived evidence summary): Pair filenames with imageinfo main images based on Commons pageid, first delineate main specimen boundaries and count them, then check whether the purple on the specimen itself is continuous and whether repeating crystal face textures are indeed present; titles are checked only for identity.

Image links are fully listed below in each member step. PDF members use official attachments and page positioning; web images use saved img src, imageinfo, or IIIF records. Visual observations come from the specified source images and are not inferred from names or search summaries.

Result of this step: Confirm that the image units to be judged correspond one-to-one with the 15-row member list.
